trap.label: who × which
trap.wrong: The cartoon shows a man which is trusting his feed.
trap.right: The cartoon shows a man who is trusting his feed.
trap.why: Em português “que” serve para pessoa e coisa. Em inglês, para pessoas use who/that, não which.

mcq.q: To describe the first scene, begin with...
Which noun phrase names the idea of seeing only similar views?

fix.wrong: The humour is from the algorithm.
fix.right: The humour comes from the algorithm.

fix.wrong: I find it funny because of the algorithm recommends only likes.
fix.right: I find it funny because the algorithm recommends only likes.

fix.wrong: The cartoon show a like-minded circle.
fix.right: The cartoon shows a like-minded circle.

rewrite.prompt: Una com who: “I see a woman. She scrolls all night.”
rewrite.answer: I see a woman who scrolls all night.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com The message is that: “The cartoon warns that filters are risky.”
rewrite.answer: The message is that filters are risky.
